decisions.selected_option: Develop the program-control layer as a reviewable candidate under CSL-204.
rejected_options: Continue the month with only loosely related implementation issues.
Treat autonomous agent recommendations as accepted product decisions.
decisions.rationale: Parallel development needs versioned lineage, evidence promotion, human decisions, integration checkpoints, and stop conditions.
conditions: No merge, deployment, credential, spending, or downstream product authorization.
Final contract acceptance remains a separate human decision on the exact reviewed candidate.
decisions.revisit_trigger: The candidate changes product authority, public semantics, or the accepted program boundary.

work_items.recovery: Revert the CSL-204 candidate; no external state is mutated.
work_items.rollback: Remove the candidate documents and checker before merge.
stop_conditions: A protected authority-path change becomes necessary.
The candidate would infer human approval or enable dependent product work.
The deterministic gate cannot distinguish candidate status from acceptance.

evidence.limitations: Structure and fixtures are not yet independently verified or Owner-accepted.

unknowns.exposure: The implementer may have missed a structural or semantic defect.
Dependent issues cannot inherit the candidate as an accepted contract.

risks.mitigation: Keep contracts candidate, require exact-digest human receipts, and fail closed on missing references.
risks.trigger: A dependent issue treats this PR, an agent recommendation, or a merge as product approval.

risks.mitigation: Require deep research only for consequential questions and inherit accepted parent evidence for mechanical children.
risks.trigger: Control work delays bounded implementation without reducing a named risk.
